text_block_list.text:
On the way back from our outing, as Cesario and I
walked down a bustling street—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that cake shop...!
Thank goodness, the event is still going on!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, I got carried away all on my own.
Trainer, do you know what a fève is?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"They're tiny figurines about the size of broad beans.
There are all kinds, like cakes, adorable animals, moons, princes, and so on..."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Collecting them has been a little hobby of mine
ever since I was little.
I even display them on the desk in my room.

Cesario beams with a radiant smile.
If she loves it that much, maybe I should buy something to decorate the Trainer's office with.
choice_data_list: Can you buy a fève at that shop?
Can you buy a fève at that shop?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Umm...
To be precise, it's more like 'you can get it if you're lucky', I suppose.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: They sell fèves at variety stores, but originally, it's something that comes out of a cake called galette des rois.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
When the family gathers at New Year's,
everyone eats a cake with a fève inside, and—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: "It is said that whoever finds the fève will enjoy a year of good fortune, acting as a form of divination."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: That shop is offering cakes with fèves inside for a limited time.
choice_data_list: Then shall we test our luck together!
Then wanna test our luck together!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Wah, are you sure!?
Thank you, Trainer♪

text_block_list.name: Cafe Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for waiting.
Here are your two Galettes des Rois.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Wah...! It's finally time♪

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...Since the cake is sliced into sixths,
the odds of finding the fève are also one in six.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Now, let us cut the cake!
(Clack)

The tip of the knife hits something hard.
Holding back the urge to scream right then and there, I slice it open to find a broad-bean-sized bear rolling out.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! Fufu! You're getting way too excited, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately, my cake was completely empty.
Miracles really don't happen that easily, do they?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
And so, Trainer, you are the king for today.
Congratulations♪

What does she mean by 'king'?
As I tilted my head in confusion, Cesario clapped her hands and said,
'Oh, that reminds me, I forgot to mention.'

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Besides telling your fortune for the year, finding the fève also means deciding the king of the day—in other words, the star of the show.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
The King may issue orders
to anyone who did not get a fève.
choice_data_list: Can the order be... literally anything...?
Can the order be... literally anything...?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yes. If it's my Trainer, I know they wouldn't
give me an order that would trouble me.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Now, your majesty, your command!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Please let me know whatever you need.
choice_data_list: In that case, I'd love it if you made me some sweets next time.
Then, let's go watch a comedy together!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Sweets... Yes, gladly.
I shall prepare something easy to eat that can accompany your research.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Just for reference, could you tell me your favorites, Trainer?
I'd love to gift you something you enjoy.

Asked by Cesario, I told her my taste in sweets.
She seemed to get a clear idea, and told me to look forward to it in the coming days.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Um... are you really sure I can have this fève?
Even though you're the one who found it, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Of course. Add it to your collection.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
A comedy...? That's just my own hobby, you know.
Are you sure you want to give an order like that?
choice_data_list: Because it seems like it'd be more fun to watch together.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...That sounds just like you, Trainer.
Have you decided on a play yet?
If you'd like, I can recommend some theater troupes to you.

We gather around the smartphone and discuss which play to see.
Tickets were still available for the show we wanted, so we booked them on the spot.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Um... are you really sure I can have this fève?
Even though you're the one who found it, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Of course. Add it to your collection.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...Well then, I'll take you up on that offer.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, what a lovely little bear♪
Center stage on my desk is yours for a while.

Seeing how she stroked its head with her fingertips,
I felt truly glad I gave it to her.
She really does seem to love fèves.
choice_data_list: So why'd you start collecting fèves?
Why did you start collecting fèves?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
There's no grand reason for it.
I just saw it in a little variety store,
wanted it so badly, and begged my parents for it—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
But it'd be lonely with just one, so I saved up
my allowance to gather more friends...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"Before I knew it, I had gathered quite a collection.
Lately, I've been hooked on arranging them to reenact my favorite comedies."
choice_data_list: That sort of thing is surprisingly fun, huh!
That sort of thing is surprisingly fun, isn't it!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, can you tell? It's true.
Just the other day, I got completely absorbed in it too...
Cesario talked on and on without stopping, and we had a wonderful time until we got back to the academy.
